item.title: Authorities continue search for 20 year old man who fell through ice trying to rescue his dog
item.description: In Clinton, County, Illinois, recovery efforts are continuing in New Baden after a 20-year-old man fell through a frozen pond on Monday. According to the New Baden Fire Department, the man had been trying to rescue his dog that had been running on the ice before the ice cracked and the dog fell in. item.title: After vehicle fire extinguished by firemen abandoned puppy left in back seat
item.description: At the Cape Girardeau Fire Department in Missouri, on January 26, when the outdoor temperature read only 13 degrees Fahrenheit, Engine I responded to a vehicle on fire and extinguished it. Shortly after the fire had been extinguished, one of the firemen discovered a young puppy in the backseat of the vehicle. item.title: Firemen in Rhode Island rescue goose stuck in ice on local pond
item.description: On Monday morning, rescuers from the Tiverton Fire Department in Rhode Island rescued a Canada goose stuck in the snow on the frozen Stafford Pond. item.title: UPDATE: Authorities recover young man who fell through ice and drowned trying to rescue his dog
item.description: In Clinton, County, Illinois, first responders confirmed they recovered the body of a man in his 20s who fell through the ice while trying to rescue his dog from a frozen pond in Clinton County on Monday. item.title: Jury reached guilty verdict within 30 minutes for man who abused puppy ‘Sweet Pea’
item.description: In Live Oak, Florida, a jury of his peers reached a guilty verdict for Eric Roldan, who police said slammed a 10-week-old puppy onto the ground and stepped on her, leaving her with a cracked skull, brain swelling and a shattered nasal cavity. item.title: Abandoned dog rescued from massive snowstorm after 6 days in freezing temps
item.description: On Tuesday, a dog now dubbed Lala, was rescued in Needham, Massachusetts after being exposed to a massive snowstorm and below freezing temperatures for six days.
